primitives.name: Task State Transition Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Never stop to ask a question: if a task is blocked, mark its ledger row BLOCKED with the reason and move to the next task.** Read `docs/business/GSE-BUSINESS-PLAN-2026.md` and `docs/ops/MASTER-PLAN-2026-08-19.md` first.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'task identifier (dimensionless)', 'S(T)': 'state of task T (BLOCKED, UNPUSHED, PUSHED)', 'R(T)': 'reason for blocking (string)'}
primitives.assumptions: Tasks form a partially ordered set under dependency relations; blocking is deterministic.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S(T) = BLOCKED, T cannot advance until R(T) resolves.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a finite-state machine where each task is a node and transitions are guarded by ledger conditions.
layer2.telemetry: Ledger row status change from UNPUSHED to BLOCKED

primitives.name: Branch Isolation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Standing rules (every task) - Branch per task: `hermes/b<N>-<slug>` from latest `origin/claude/cron-config-placement-verify-qsl19t`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B(T)': 'branch name for task T (string)', 'C(T)': 'commit hash of task T (hex string)', 'S': 'source branch reference (string)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each task has unique branch; no cross-task contamination.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When B(T) conflicts with existing branch, task fails to initialize.

layer2.mapping: Derived from Git branching model with task-specific namespace enforcement.

primitives.name: Guardrail Validation Predicate
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Before every commit, ALL of: `npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/web` (0 errors), `node scripts/guardrails/trust-gate.mjs` (OK), `node scripts/ops/check-agent-ledger.mjs` (OK, check the real exit code — do not pipe it).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G': 'set of guardrail checks (dimensionless)', 'V(g_i)': 'validation result for check g_i (boolean)', 'C': 'commit operation (function)'}
primitives.assumptions: All guardrails are necessary and sufficient for correctness.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If ∃g_i ∈ G such that V(g_i) = false, C is rejected.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a conjunction of boolean predicates in a validation pipeline.
layer2.telemetry: Exit codes from each guardrail script
